writeup: TIC 65970288 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 1.3705 days. TESS photometry shows a primary eclipse with a depth of 1.17 percent dimming, detected at high significance with a BLS signal-to-noise ratio of 52.8. Pixel-level analysis using difference imaging confirms a peak signal-to-noise of 11.8, though the centroid offset measures 1.2 arcsec from the target position. No secondary eclipse was detected in the data. This candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, suggesting it may represent a novel target. The pipeline's machine-learning model assigned it a screening score of 0.37, and the photometric data passed all quality checks without flags.
